regions.today: Dry this evening with hazy sunshine and light winds.
regions.tonight: Mainly dry tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. There's just the chance of a few isolated showers later in the night. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees in light to moderate easterly or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Monday, will continue to bring a good lot of dry weather, with some hazy spells of sunshine in the morning. Becoming cloudier from the west as the day goes on, bringing a little light rain or drizzle. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees in light to moderate mainly southeasterly winds, gradually veering southwesterly.
regions.solar_uv: Generally low to moderate on Monday and Tuesday, but high in sunshine.
